documented_policy.autopay_activation: immediate; first draft on following due date
documented_policy.email_billing: eBill enrollment through municipal website (separate from the payment portal); paper stops after the confirmation email is delivered; unsubscribe by completing the form again
documented_policy.city_bank_draft: Separate form-based Automatic Bill Payment Option (bank draft) returned to ubcontact@tuscaloosa.com; cancellation by form. Not an online flow.

synthetic_rules.charges: Water 11.26 + 0.38/unit, sewer 12.40 + 0.45/unit, garbage 17.50 (synthetic; the posted rate schedule PDF was not modeled).
synthetic_rules.password_policy: 8-64 characters, at least one letter and one number, no spaces.
synthetic_rules.nsf_trigger: New bank account numbers ending 0009 are returned when drafted by AutoPay or a scheduled payment; the documented $30 fee is then billed.
synthetic_rules.confirmation_email_delay: Delivered immediately (live delay documented as 5-10 minutes).
synthetic_rules.posting: Immediate posting for same-day payments; due-date drafts at 06:00 UTC on simulated clock advance; no retries or catch-up.
synthetic_rules.payments_apply: Account balance, oldest unpaid bill first; amount may not exceed the balance.

fidelity_limits: The Paymentus tenant (ipn4.paymentus.com/cp/tusl) returns HTTP 403 to automated fetches; portal layout follows the Paymentus family guide documented for Batavia and is not a capture of Tuscaloosa's portal.
HTTP 403 assets belong to the failure response and are not reused as application code.
PayPal, PayPal Credit, Venmo, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Amazon Pay are documented but shown as unavailable locally; only bank and card checkout are implemented.
The Smartsheet eBill form fields are reconstructed; the live form was not rendered or submitted.
Bill amounts, usage, statement PDF layout, confirmation numbers and timing are synthetic.
No production form was submitted and no live account was accessed.
